description_en: You can invoke ListCustomCallTagging to obtain the list of inbound number marks under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListCustomCallTagging获取指定实例下的呼入号码标记列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-custom-call-tagging --instance-id ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-pattern 13121210000 --call-tag-name-list TagA --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomCallTagging

parameters.help_en: Perform fuzzy matching based on number or description. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. An empty value indicates no filtering
parameters.help_zh: 根据号码或描述进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.help_en: Filter by a list of number tag names. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty, which means no filtering is applied. The format is a JSON array string, where each array element is a number tag name
parameters.help_zh: 按号码标签名称列表过滤，非必填，默认为空，表示不过滤。格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是号码标签名称
parameters.name: call_tag_name_list
